Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

🆕 New (Published: October 15, 2026)

Hanno City's Disaster Prevention Radio voice response service is temporarily suspended.

【Cause】
Arcadia Corporation, which operates the system integration, has experienced an unauthorized access by a third party, and there is a possibility that personal information has been leaked.

【Services currently suspended】
• Website where Hanno City Disaster Prevention Radio broadcast content can be viewed
• Hanno City Facebook
• Hanno City Disaster Prevention X (formerly Twitter)
• Yahoo! Disaster Prevention Alert app

【Status of response】
An investigation into the impact on the system is currently underway. The restoration date and time are undetermined.

【Important note】
There is a risk that registered email addresses and other information may be misused. Please be careful of suspicious emails from unknown senders.

For details, please check the official homepage of Arcadia Corporation.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/emergency/14523.html
summary: ℹ️ Hanno City Disaster Prevention Radio Voice Response Service temporarily suspended
